group1_standard.notes: Mon-Thu full 24h, Friday full 24h (0-23), Sat/Sun closed

group2_eur_cross.notes: Mon-Thu full 24h, Friday 0-19, Sat/Sun closed. No Sunday open observed.

rollover_convention.observed: No systematic intraday rollover gaps detected
rollover_convention.detail: All 7 group-1 symbols and 3 eur-cross symbols have continuous hourly bars Mon-Fri within their open windows. No recurring daily maintenance gap aligned to a fixed hour was found.

dst_behavior.observed: No DST-specific shift in UTC bar boundaries detected
dst_behavior.detail: All timestamps are UTC-anchored. Weekly open/close are constant in UTC across the full period, indicating the provider publishes fixed UTC bar timestamps independent of local DST.

critical_finding_84_8_pattern.explanation: The 84.8% target coverage in GBPUSD, USDJPY, GBPJPY, CHFJPY, GBPCHF was NOT a session-calendar defect.
critical_finding_84_8_pattern.root_cause:
These five
 symbol '"M5"' files contain DAILY-ONLY bars (one bar per day at 00:00:00) from 2022-01-03 through 2022-09-12 (~378 daily bars), then transition to genuine 5-minute data at 2022-09-13 01:00:00 UTC. Resampling these daily bars to 'H1' produced only ~1 H1 bar per day for the early period, collapsing coverage.
critical_finding_84_8_pattern.evidence: First 5-min bar detected at 2022-09-13 00:55:00 (GBPUSD, USDJPY, GBPJPY, GBPCHF) and 2022-09-13 01:00:00 for CHFJPY.
critical_finding_84_8_pattern.conclusion: When coverage is measured from each symbol's TRUE M5 availability start (not 2022-01-01), all 7 group-1 symbols reach 99.3-99.4% coverage.

eurusd_usdchf_missing_history_cause.explanation: EURUSD and USDCHF raw files begin at 2023-07-03. No 2022-01-01 to 2023-07-02 data exists in the local library, MT5 exports, or alternate raw directories (data/raw/MetaQuotes-Demo and data/raw/raw were empty). A re-export from MT5 for 2022-2023 would be required to extend these to the 2022 target start.
eurusd_usdchf_missing_history_cause.conclusion: Genuine missing source history - not a normalization defect.

eur_cross_common_gap_cause.explanation: EURGBP, EURJPY, EURCHF had residual ~170-177 missing hours in the common window. Analysis showed these are driven by the correct Friday-with-19:00-UTC-close session convention, NOT a source defect. With the empirically-corrected Group-2 calendar (Mon 00:00 - Fri 19:00), their common coverage is 98.99-99.03%, and the residual missing hours are isolated small gaps.
eur_cross_common_gap_cause.conclusion: Prior ~95% reading was caused by an incorrect assumed calendar (Sun 20:00 open). Corrected to Mon-Fri with 19:00 Friday close, all 3 reach >=98.99%.
